newsitem.title: POLAND: Polfa to invest PLN 40 mln in OTC drugs.
newsitem.headline: Polfa to invest PLN 40 mln in OTC drugs.

text.p: Polish drug maker Polfa Kutno SA has signed a contract with an Italian drug firm to expand its production of over-the-counter drugs, a project in which Polfa will invest 40 million zlotys, Polfa's deputy president said.

"We have signed a contract with an Italian company to buy a licence and produce their drugs on the Polish market....The completion of the new division will cost 40 million zlotys," Jan Krysiuk told Reuters on Tuesday.
He would not name the Italian firm.
Krysiuk said the new division, which would produce non-regulated OTC drugs, should be completed in the first quarter of next year.
He said Polfa did not have the resources to conduct its own research and development and so would produce generic drugs and buy licences.
Krysiuk said Polfa was also holding talks with a Danish firm and another licence contract would be signed this month.
He said his firm's 1997 net profit forecast of 20.7 million zlotys was still on target. Last year the firm netted 16 million zlotys.
